terms.comment: A modern loan word, not in Lewis & Short; the Roman liquid measure nearest it is the congius, about three litres (Lewis & Short).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 216, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
